We’re happy to help you compare options, though we can only use general mattress info here.

Based on our main types:

Spring mattress: Best if you’re heavier, want strong support/responsiveness.
Hybrid mattress: Good mix of support and pressure relief.
Memory foam/latex/foam: Better for contouring and pressure relief, with varying support and breathability.

For heavier sleepers (230+ lb), a spring or hybrid with medium‑firm feel (5–6) and good edge support is typically more suitable, as it balances support and plushness.

For sleep position:

Side sleepers: Softer to medium (1–6) for pressure relief.
Back/stomach sleepers: Firmer (7–10) for better support.

For room size and sleepers:

One person: Twin, Twin XL, or Full (Full can fit two tightly).
Couples: Queen is most popular; King/Cal King for more space or taller people.

If you share your weight range, sleep position, and whether you sleep alone or with a partner, we can narrow which general type (spring, hybrid, memory foam, latex, or foam) is likely better for you.
